title: Tell on-call which account has no invoice address

blocks.text: The invoicing run e-mails each invoice to the account's billing address. Last night it stopped halfway with nothing in the log but `java.util.NoSuchElementException: No value present`, and the on-call engineer spent an hour finding out which of 30,000 accounts caused it.

Write `invoiceAddress(accountId)` in `src/main/java/practice/BillingContacts.java`. An account without a billing e-mail is normal: its invoices go to `RECEIVABLES`. An invoice for an account that doesn't exist is a bug upstream, and the run should fail with an `UnknownAccountException` that says which account it was. `find` and `Account.billingEmail()` already return `Optional`. About four lines.

cases.says: an account with a billing e-mail gets its invoice there
an unknown account fails with UnknownAccountException naming the account
an account that exists but has no billing e-mail gets the receivables address

origin.section: Optional Is a Return Type, and get() Without a Check Only Renames the NullPointerException

concepts: Optional.get() on an empty Optional throws NoSuchElementException with no context; orElseThrow with an exception that names the key tells on-call what failed.
